virtualList.$description: VirtualList's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--virtual-list-<name>) on the page, a container or one VirtualList, and every VirtualList inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults. Its rows, lines and frame read List's tokens.

focus-ring.$description: The ring around the list while it has keyboard focus (3:1).

height.$description: The most the list grows to before it scrolls inside (384px).
